# Mental Health Strategy

This folder contains the core political and clinical strategies shaping ADHD care in Denmark. It includes the national 10-Year Plan, a political initiative aimed at reversing negative trends in psychiatric care through increased resource allocation and cross-systemic collaboration. Alongside this, the folder holds two major clinical guidelines from the multidisciplinary psychiatric groups (DMPG) that establish normative frameworks for the non-pharmacological treatment and diagnostic assessment of children and adolescents. Together, these documents bridge high-level policy with daily clinical practice, directly informing national quality indicators and standardizing care across hospitals and specialist clinics.

## Pages

- [[10-aars-planen|10 års planen]] — The national political strategy designed to improve ADHD outcomes and reverse negative trends in Danish psychiatric care through increased resource allocation.
- [[dmpg-retningslinje|DMPG-retningslinje]] — The professional clinical guideline for non-pharmacological ADHD treatment, which informs national quality metrics for psychoeducation and social support.
- [[dmpg-retningslinjen-udredning-af-adhd-hos-boern-og-unge-i-hospitalsregi-og-speciallaegepraksis|"DMPG-retningslinjen: Udredning af ADHD hos børn og unge i hospitalsregi og speciallægepraksis"]] — The 2025 clinical framework for assessing ADHD in youth, which standardizes diagnostic elements and shapes quality indicators like Indikator 3.
